events.evidence: Modulated swishing between peaks matches the sponge sliding across the pan interior.
Diffuse raspy swells align with back-and-forth sponge strokes against the pan.
Uneven broadband swells match repeated sponge strokes from the lower interior to the right inner wall.
Sharp attacks with short resonant tails align with the sponge turning at the pan wall and recontacting the interior.
A hollow knock rings out as the sponge reaches the upper inner rim and the pan shifts upward.
Sharp knocks align with sponge-to-rim contact, a brief pan shift under the sponge, and the pan lowering into the basin.
